final_answer:
Condition C2 was compared with vector RAG (SS) on comprehensiveness in both the Podcast and News datasets. For the Podcast dataset, all global search conditions (C0-C3) and source text summarization (TS) had greater comprehensiveness than vector RAG (SS), and the differences were statistically significant (p < .05) in all cases [2]. Specifically, this includes C2 showing higher comprehensiveness than SS.

Similarly, for the News dataset, all global search conditions (C0-C3) and TS also showed greater comprehensiveness than vector RAG (SS), with statistically significant differences (p < .05) in all cases [2]. This indicates that condition C2 also outperformed SS in comprehensiveness for the News dataset.
